title: Its My Rocket
description: Removes the national flags off the NTM Space rocket parts
body:
Simply removes the American flags off the rocket parts in NTM: Space, there is no reason for them to be there as it is a custom rocket of your own design America had no hand in its creation.

also they're just ugly, instead it replaces them with a tasteful gear on the landing capsule and simply paints over the others.
